sentences.text: Ptyktoptychion was an extinct genus of chimaeras, a member of the class Chondrichthyes. It belongs to the family Callorhinchidae and the subfamily Callorhynchinae.
The species Ptyktoptychion tayyo was described by Lees in 1986, while Ptyktoptychion wadeae was later described by Bartholomai in 2008.
This animal lived in Australia during the Early Cretaceous period, specifically between 106.3 and 100.5 million years ago in the Albian stage.
